Function.Name: AddSteps
Function.Description: Spills that many totals, counting the start as the first.

Argument.Name: Start
Argument.Description: Starting number. Counted as the first total.

Argument.Name: Times
Argument.Description: How many totals, including the start. 1 to 99.

Argument.Name: Gap
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE leaves a blank cell between totals.

Argument.Name: Pad
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE returns padded text such as 01. Omit it for numbers.

Argument.Name: Down
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE spills down. Omit it for a row.

Argument.Name: Split
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE puts each digit, and a decimal point, in its own cell.

Function.Name: TimesSteps
Function.Description: Spills the number times 1 through the count.

Argument.Name: Times
Argument.Description: How many products, from 1 through this count. 1 to 99.

Argument.Name: Gap
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE leaves a blank cell between products.

Argument.Name: Pad
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE returns padded text such as 08. Omit it for numbers.

Argument.Name: Down
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE spills down. Omit it for a row.

Argument.Name: Split
Argument.Description: Optional. TRUE puts each digit, and a decimal point, in its own cell.
